puzzle.goal: A collector far from a star sees its disc fill a cone of half-angle θ_s around the line of sight. Every direction inside that cone delivers the star's surface radiance B. Write the power per unit area falling on a collector facing the star by integrating the radiance, projected onto the collector's normal, over the solid angle of the cone.
puzzle.name: Irradiance from a uniform stellar disc (radiance integrated over solid angle)
puzzle.form: int ( 0 , 2 * π , int ( 0 , θ _ s , B * cos ( θ ) * sin ( θ ) , θ ) , φ )
puzzle.ask: The integral gives πB·sin²θ_s = σT⁴(R/r)² = L/(4πr²). Find the flux at r = 1.496e11 m from a star of luminosity L = 3.828e26 W.

vars.\u03b8: angle from the line of sight
vars.\u03c6: azimuth around the line of sight
vars.s: label: the edge of the stellar disc

puzzle.method: In spherical angles the solid-angle element is sinθ dθ dφ; the flat collector picks up a cosθ projection factor.
